newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilians bounce more checks in January - banks.
newsitem.headline: Brazilians bounce more checks in January - banks.

text.p: The number of bounced checks in Brazil rose 23 percent in January against the previous month, the Centralized Bank Services (Serasa) said.
Serasa said in a statement 0.51 percent of the total 270 million checks cleared last month were bounced.
The increase in the number of bounced checks last month was mainly because of an increase in the use of post-dated checks during the Christmas season.

Since the introduction of the Real stabilization plan in July 1994, Brazilians have been using post-dated checks as a form of credit, replacing the use of credit cards and other credit instruments, Serasa said.
Currently, 70 percent of all checks cleared in Brazil are post-dated checks, it added.
